limits: Explicit read-only allocation census, not a future allocation estimator or an integrity/production-admission capability.

correctness_reviews: Allocator allocation bits may lie beyond the physical file or have no Catalog owner; inspecting Catalog or file slots alone cannot prove complete allocation accounting.
Logical-bootstrap allocator traversal validates route/level/generation, reports page/visitor limits as incomplete and preserves registered old roots.
Retired Catalog pools and relocated sources are separate charges; a retired-segment queue entry must not charge its Catalog slot twice.
Emergency reserve is a real allocated pool absent from normal Catalog ownership.

A current generation and stable IO epoch are required for a measured census; a saturated epoch is unknown, and an interrupted native writer conservatively requests recovery when the epoch cannot signal changes.
